decisions.reason: Operator training builds on the firm's established service offer, costs little to carry, and supports machine sales, so keeping the option open is cheap and useful.
The fourth rotary axis accessory is a low-cost add-on complementing the core milling machines, so its carrying cost is small relative to its continuing value.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core and was only mentioned on the website, but its uncertain upside in future-oriented production fits the firm's strategic direction, so the option is still worth holding.
The high-speed CNC milling line sits close to the firm's core business, had its own page, and is central to the firm's value, so dropping it is unlikely.
The automatic tool change system strengthens the core machines' productivity at modest incremental cost, so it remains worth keeping.
